item.title: Apple’s Next Chapter, SpaceX and Cursor Strike a Deal, and Palantir’s Controversial Manifesto
item.description: In this week’s episode of Uncanny Valley, we talk about Tim Cook’s legacy as CEO at Apple and what his long-rumored departure means for the future of one of the world's biggest companies.

item.title: At 'AI Coachella,' Stanford Students Line Up to Learn From Silicon Valley Royalty
item.description: CS 153 has gone viral on the Palo Alto campus—and on X. Not everyone is happy about it.

item.title: Sam Altman’s Orb Company Promoted a Bruno Mars Partnership That Doesn't Exist
item.description: “To be clear, we were never approached … nor were we in any discussions regarding a partnership or tour access,” a spokesperson for the artist tells WIRED.

item.title: 5 AI Models Tried to Scam Me. Some of Them Were Scary Good
item.description: The cyber capabilities of AI models have experts rattled. AI’s social skills may be just as dangerous.

item.title: AI Tools Are Helping Mediocre North Korean Hackers Steal Millions
item.description: One group of hackers used AI for everything from vibe coding their malware to creating fake company websites—and stole as much as $12 million in three months.

item.title: Join Our Livestream: Musk v. Altman and the Future of OpenAI
item.description: On May 8, we’re going live to answer your questions about the Musk v. Altman trial that could determine the fate of OpenAI.

item.title: The Pope’s Warnings About AI Were AI-Generated, a Detection Tool Claims
item.description: Pangram Labs’ updated Chrome extension puts warning labels on AI slop as you scroll your social feeds.

item.title: OpenAI Beefs Up ChatGPT’s Image Generation Model
item.description: The ChatGPT Images 2.0 model is here. Our testing shows it’s better at creating more detailed images and rendering text, but it still struggles with languages other than English.

item.title: Mozilla Used Anthropic’s Mythos to Find and Fix 271 Bugs in Firefox
item.description: The Firefox team doesn’t think emerging AI capabilities will upend cybersecurity long term, but they warn that software developers are likely in for a rocky transition.

item.title: Tim Cook’s Legacy Is Turning Apple Into a Subscription
item.description: The soon-to-exit Apple CEO went all in on services. Now, the incoming CEO, John Ternus, will need to embrace the AI era.
